ingest.note: Accepts text via the streaming WebSocket with voice + language params.

egress.note: Output format is configurable: pcm_s16le, pcm_f32le, pcm_mulaw, pcm_alaw at 8000/16000/22050/24000/44100/48000 Hz. Default 24kHz PCM. Can emit μ-law 8kHz directly for telephony.

potholes.note: Cartesia defaults to 24 kHz PCM. For telephony, request output_format={encoding: pcm_mulaw, sample_rate: 8000} to skip your own encode stage, or resample + encode yourself.
Audio arrives as variable-size PCM chunks over WebSocket. Buffer and chunk-align before resampling for the telephony leg.
